Description: Assigned participant identifier.
Participant gender: "M" (male); "F" (female); "NB" (non-binary); "GNC" (gender nonconforming/gender queer); "A" (agender); "TS" (two spirit)

Participant ethicity: "B" (Black/African American); "W" (White/Caucasian); "A" (Asian); "ME" (Middle Eastern/Arab); "L" (Latino/Hispanic); "NAT" (Native American/Alaskan Native/First Nation); "PI" (Native Hawaiian/Pacific Islander)
Participant age in years.
Response to survey question: "how important is music to you?" (rating: 1, not at all; 7, extremely).
Self-reported hours per week listening to music. Participants' free responses binned into one of four categories: 0-9 hours, 10-19 hours, 20-29 hours, Over 30 hours.
Response to survey question: "would you consider youself to be an active musician?" (yes/no)

Level of musical training/experience: 0 (none); 1 (minimal); 2 (moderate); 3 (significant). Participants' free responses ("briefly describe your level of music training/experience") were coded by researchers.
Raw-addition score on the extended Barcelona Music Reward Questionnaire. Note that a score of less than or equal to 69 has been used as an indicator of musical anhedonia.
Raw-addition score on the extended Barcelona Music Reward Questionnaire "music-seeking" subscale.
Raw-addition score on the extended Barcelona Music Reward Questionnaire "emotion-evocation" subscale.
Raw-addition score on the extended Barcelona Music Reward Questionnaire "mood-regulation" subscale.
Raw-addition score on the extended Barcelona Music Reward Questionnaire "sensory-motor" subscale.
Raw-addition score on the extended Barcelona Music Reward Questionnaire "social-reward" subscale.
Raw-addition score on the extended Barcelona Music Reward Questionnaire "absorption in music" subscale.
Factor score (T-value, mean=50, sd=10) for extended Barcelona Music Reward Questionnaire.
Factor score (T-value, mean=50, sd=10) for extended Barcelona Music Reward Questionnaire "music-seeking" subscale.
Factor score (T-value, mean=50, sd=10) for extended Barcelona Music Reward Questionnaire "emotion-evocation" subscale.
Factor score (T-value, mean=50, sd=10) for extended Barcelona Music Reward Questionnaire "mood-regulation" subscale.
Factor score (T-value, mean=50, sd=10) for extended Barcelona Music Reward Questionnaire "sensory-motor" subscale.
Factor score (T-value, mean=50, sd=10) for extended Barcelona Music Reward Questionnaire "social-reward" subscale.
Factor score (T-value, mean=50, sd=10) for extended Barcelona Music Reward Questionnaire "absorption in music" subscale.
Big Five Inventory "extraversion" subscale score (average item score).
Big Five Inventory "agreeableness" subscale score (average item score).
Big Five Inventory "conscientiousness" subscale score (average item score).
Big Five Inventory "neuroticism" subscale score (average item score).
Big Five Inventory "openness" subscale score (average item score).
Interpersonal Reactivity Index "perspective taking" subscale score (raw addition score).

Music condition heard during the trial (Two of each type per participant, labeled A or B, see "pair" attribute below): "sensory-motor" (participant-selected, structural appreciation); "self-relevant" (participant-selected, self-oriented appreciation); "peer" (experimenter-selected, deceived to think this is another listener's self-relevant song); "computer" (experimenter-selected, deceived to think this was chosen by a non-human agent).
Song title.
Song artist(s).
Song length in minutes. Derived from Spotify API "track duration ms" measure.
Spotify API "track popularity" measure (0: least popular; 100: most popular).
Spotify API "track tempo" in beats per minute, rounded to a whole number.
Spotify API "track danceability" measure (0: least danceable; 100: most danceable).
Spotify API "track energy" measure (0: low energy; 100: high energy).
Spotify API "track valence" measure (0: negative valence; 100: positive valence).
Song's Spotify ID.
Artist's Spotify ID. If the song has multiple artists, the ID listed is only for the first artist.
List of artist's genres from Spotify, genres are separated by commas.
Song YouTube link from which the audio was played for participants. Only songs used during the task have links in this column.
Used for matching purposes during the stimulus selection process. "A" songs are most similar to each other, and "B" songs are most similar to each other.
